notes.title: Version 0.7.0b Release: Hero Pack 6 (Beta Branch)
notes.notes:
Build version 0.7.0b, Hero Pack 6, is now available on the Beta Branch. This update contains 3 new wanderer heroes for you to find, some bugfixes and balance adjustments, and some new features that have been requested by players for a while. This is the final planned Hero Pack, bringing us to 100 total heroes!

Steam achievements for the new heroes are not yet available, but will be added when Hero Pack 6 leaves the beta branch. If you have feedback or bug reports on this release, or would just like to chat with other players, come and join the community on our discord at https://discord.gg/m9MAfrP !

[h3]How do I download the Beta Branch?[/h3]
Opting into a Beta branch is easy on Steam. Simply right click Time Break Chronicles in your Library, select Properties, and then click "Betas." From there you can select the Beta branch from the dropdown, and Steam will download the files for you. You do not need to enter a beta access code.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38550877/6df0b8bcc90d6be4dc7b2210893465403ecccdf1.png[/img]

[h2]Changelog for version 0.7.0b[/h2]
[list]
[*] Three new heroes added via wanderer missions after completing act 1 and 2, and reaching town level 24
[*] Rearranged singularity unlock order a little to fit in the new characters. One of them is available as a starting leader
[*] Claire can now be removed as leader when doing endless mode runs, after beating the initial "story" versions of these missions. Added some in-game lore related to it, but existing saves may miss this dialogue if already past act 1. Some heroes that rely on dying for certain skill effects are not eligible leaders.
[*] Added a Bestiary that lists enemy descriptions and their passive abilities, accessible via the town's Library or mid-mission via the ESC game menu. Bestiary entries fill out as you encounter each enemy type (not retroactive on existing saves).
[*] Battle Log will now display critical damage hits with red-tinted text
[*] Single column menus may now be scrolled through by full page using PageUp/Down or L1/L2 controller buttons
[*] Sleep and Stun numerical damage values will now be visible in battle with their own color/style
[*] Rebalanced Steam Engineer's mech related skills to allow mech to be more viable after its long build up time
[*] Changed Hellbinder's Implosion skill level 3 effect to "deal 50% more damage"
[*] Bard's song skills will now cancel other characters' song skills just like any other song (only his own songs can be stacked)
[*] Changed Bard's Master of Song lv 2 effect to reduce MP cost of song skills, instead of reducing penalty per song
[*] Viggo's Gladius relic bonus decreased from +15 to +10 per stack
[*] Horned Helmet relic bonus decreased from 35% piercing to 25% piercing, to give more space for damage specialization piercing relics
[*] Increased Booster Shot relic's bonus from 10% to 20%
[*] Increased Volatile Drone's base power substantially so its various attacks can deal more meaningful damage
[*] Reduced attribute sharing from summoner to summon a little (summon bond), but fixed the effect not applying properly to Hellbinder's Imps and Inventor's KillBot
[*] Fixed Inferno Gem relic's damage not playing a fire sound effect
[*] Fixed Raider's Scavenge trait lv 3 effect not working properly in boss/elite battles
[*] Fixed Pioneer's Survivalist trait lv 3 effect not working properly in boss/elite battles
[*] Fixed Banshee's Wail relic description to display its specific piercing bonus value
[*] Fixed a few skill descriptions not fitting into battle's skill description box
[*] Fixed a visual bug where battle menus were prematurely made visible and overlapped ESC menu after leaving glossary
[*] Fixed issue where some buff/debuff effects would not apply to characters' "on downed" skills, because the effects were removed immediately instead of after the skills were processed
[/list]

There will be another beta build or two to iron out any reported issues relating to the new content and deal with some outstanding bug reports still unresolved, after which this build will go to the main stable branch.

The next major update will be the release of Act 6, the final story act of Chronicle mode. After that, we'll be working towards the 1.0 release!

[*] Fixed lv 3 turn progress modifier being applied multiple times when Devil used Instruct on an ally that had auto trigger chained type skills (new)
[*] Fixed "Add Turn Progress" type effects being able to push a hero's turn progress beyond 100% to the next turn, in certain instances (new)

notes.title: Version 0.6.9 Release: Future Frontier
notes.notes:
Version 0.6.9 has officially left the beta branch and is now in the stable branch! We'd like to thank everyone who downloaded the beta and provided feedback and bug reports. If you'd like to join in and talk about the game or provide feedback as well, come and join the community on our discord at https://discord.gg/m9MAfrP !

Out next major release will be Hero Pack 5, and then we'll be moving on to the final act, Act 6, and the 1.0 release.

You do not need to unsubscribe from the beta branch if you are currently using it, as both beta and stable branches have been updated. Now, on to the details.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38550877/94d843ae770078f70195ce22b9a9faa9d1ac63bd.png[/img]

If you haven't been playing or following along with the beta branch, the changelog from the previous stable version, 0.5.20, is below:

[h3]New Content and Major Updates from 0.5.20[/h3]
[list]
[*] Act 5 added with 15 new heroes, new enemies, bosses, relics, and more
[*] New heroes can be unlocked in Singularity mode as usual
[*] Restructured map generation for Singularity mode to progress more logically and have the harder, later act enemies added in sequential sections instead of all mixed together
[*] Damage blocked by shield type effects now shows up in battle as a grey number with a shield icon, improving feedback for damage dealt vs missed/dodged
[*] Added an "unbind" option for infinite relics in Chronicle mode. A hero's intrinsic relics and non-infinite relics cannot be unbound.
[*] Added Act 4/5 victory stats and expanded favorite heroes to top 5 in the Hall of Records
[*] Reworked Viking somewhat to have better synergy from his Berserker and Raider passives
[*] Changed Shaolin Robe relic effect to directly reduce damage taken based on discipline
[*] Zeke's Boots relic bonus increased from 25% to 35%
[*] Increased Gamma Shard relic bonus from 15% to 20%
[*] Reduced cost of Gravity Time Break skill
[*] Return Fire skill updated to work off of any source of Protect from the same character
[*] Protect can no longer target somebody already protected
[*] Buffed a few Distortion effects that were less desirable, and added a new one (Lion Heart)
[*] Added a turn counter to highest-length stack's duration on effect icon mouseover tooltip
[*] Hit chance changed to range from 1%-99% instead of 0-100, crit chance base floor 5%. This allows pct chance modifiers to have an effect even at very low base values.
[*] Mathias' class name changed to Steam Engineer
[*] Reworked a couple of Bard's skills
[*] Moved Inscriber and Frozen form Claire's drones to drone slot, so they don't block other summon skills and can exist at the same time
[*] Adjusted some of Dark Knight's skill modifier values
[*] Changed Steam Engineer's Steam Mech skill to give 50% increased attributes at lv 3, instead of reduced stun/sleep damage taken
[*] Drone Parts relic will no longer summon lower tier drones, based on completed acts/singularity tiers
[*] Increased Consecrate/Desecrate skill MP cost a little
[*] Reworked Big Blob boss's split mechanic to always happen in-between turns, to make it more consistent, and address some bugs
[*] Buffed Flame Fist enemy's Flame Rush fire damage over time effect
[*] Changed Chill Fist enemy's passive from Flash Freeze to an armor skill, and buffed its Snow Plow attack
[*] Self-targeted AoE skills used by a summon will now use their summoner's party position as the center when hitting allies. This also fixes a couple crashes with Cop's summon ability
[*] Taunt cannot be used by summons
[*] Pursuer, Angel, and Fallen reclassified to Anomaly type
[*] Enemy HP increased a little in general for the highest level enemies, with an extra HP modifier for hard/insane difficulties on acts 3 and up
[*] Decreased/removed player "pity" bonuses to hit chance and dodge chance for hard/insane difficulties
[*] Fixed a possible rare crash in certain situations when leaving a battle
[*] Fixed Duality of Being passive giving 35% bonus instead of listed 25% for lv 2/3
[*] Fixed Marine's Covering Fire ability not correctly reporting hit chance as 100 in battle
[*] Fixed Throw Spear skill's Lv 2 effect adding 50% bonus to all critical damage instead of just Throw Spear
[*] Fixed Meditate skill applying its lv 3 effect at lv 1

[h2]New Mechanic: Instability[/h2]
The major change added in this patch is a new mechanic called [b]"Instability."[/b] As a battle goes on and energy is released, instability of local space-time increases, and so does damage dealt by both allies AND enemies. notes.title: Version 0.4.6 Release: Quest Update
notes.notes:
Version 0.4.6 has officially left the beta branch and is now in the stable branch! We'd like to thank everyone who downloaded the beta and provided feedback and bug reports. If you'd like to join in and talk about the game or provide feedback as well, come and join the community on our discord at https://discord.gg/m9MAfrP !

Our next major update will be Hero Pack #3, introducing 3 new wanderer heroes into the fray.

You do not need to unsubscribe from the beta branch if you are currently using it, as both beta and stable branches have been updated.

Now, on to the details of the major new features from the previous stable version of 0.3.10. We previously outlined these features in a developer update, but we'll go over them again here if you missed it.  A changelog specifically for version 0.4.6 is at the bottom of this post.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38550877/eb1eb69fbd01393f35a3f4c3b1847bf2613525a7.jpg[/img]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38550877/f62f7b23cdcb492aa36791616e3aa62a779c3e99.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38550877/a0e19ef365efa1d54974c958a8d46d8333887307.jpg[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38550877/5c1046c800e6b88ed3b19aa270f23d0246b393b2.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38550877/552f3fb1efcc338bdad6398d15d95cd7d6c27993.jpg[/img][/url]
[h2]Hero Quests, XP, and Skill Points[/h2]
One of the most frequent things we've heard from players is that the game tends to involve too much "grinding" to find the appropriate skill books to level up, and to acquire the relics you most want to use. It would be much more fun to just play the game, using the various heroes available as best you can, and make progress as you go!

To address this, we've removed all the various skill book types except for Encyclopedia (which has a heavily reduced drop rate), and added a new system for leveling up skills. Heroes will instead earn skill points through 3 different methods: 
[list]
[*] Defeating bosses for the first time to earn a [b]Boss Badge[/b]
[*] Earning [b]XP[/b] in battles like a traditional RPG
[*] Completing specific [b]Hero Quests[/b]
[/list]You can then spend the skill points to level up skills, even mid-mission. This system also serves to help us level out the difficulty curve from Act 1 to Act 2, since you'll be steadily earning skill points instead of getting books in small dumps. Several bosses have received updates or overhauls to better match the new difficulty curve; some are now a bit easier, and some a bit harder.

Every hero has 3 unique quests that, when completed, award them skill points and another new feature: an [b]Infinite Relic[/b]. Claire also has several quests tailored for her various forms.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38550877/141346585475bfb1af934c576e98fb45a0865c6f.jpg[/img]
[h2]Infinite Relics[/h2]
By completing the relevant quests, hero-specific relics can now become infinite. Infinite relics can be duplicated as many times as you want for free, allowing you more freedom to bind them to any hero you'd like.

Boss relics, shop relics, and relics found only via missions will still need to be either found or crafted, but this also serves to make them a bit more special, and will allow us to add a few more of them as well.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38550877/9d295959c1f79d0414c026e0e92cbe528e2d7b7d.jpg[/img]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38550877/46c2fc526f764d0821e971712e59d42ae767c50a.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38550877/4ac40505896fdeaddfdbb11115abb21828ce8b21.jpg[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38550877/16fdf4f006b12bacb8418a21cbef783ea51f6094.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38550877/93d3d2df6563033262646fc11a91972a8acbd97c.jpg[/img][/url]
[h2]Town Progress Meter and Building Upgrade Overhaul[/h2]
Another point of feedback has been that the building upgrades aren't as interesting as they could be, they cost too much, and there's too many options presented at once. Now that particles don't need to be spent primarily on acquiring skill books and relics, a larger focus will be on purchasing building upgrades.

We've reduced the cost of the building upgrades in general, and reworked many of them to provide more interesting effects that add more "flavor" to various damage types or situations. In addition, instead of purchasing the buildings, they will be unlocked via a town progress bar that increases as you rescue and level up new heroes. This also further serves to incentivize trying out new heroes and completing their quests.

The Town Progress bar also unlocks other things over time, such as Time Break techs, additional reserve and bundle slots, and Skill Points for Claire.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38550877/ad6a248d3a4ff19ff21756966ee6d59bd9ac1273.jpg[/img]
[h2]Endless Mode Overhaul[/h2]
Endless mode has also received a facelift. It will now work similarly to Singularity mode, in that each level will present a set of specific challenges, instead of simply increasing the levels of the enemies. Defeat the final challenge, and you might even find something special!

Speaking of Singularity mode, heroes in that mode will also now earn XP like they do in Chronicle. This allows for a bit more creativity when choosing your rewards after the battle, since encyclopedias won't be quite as important to take.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38550877/2a2fefd271fdabb02089da330dbcb39297a632f2.jpg[/img]
[h2]Special Missions[/h2]
With the overhaul to Endless mode, wanderer hero rescues have now been moved to a new [b]Special Missions[/b] feature. At certain times, Quinn will present Special Missions aside the main story to earn special rewards. These are short custom-crafted missions with unique encounters, leading to a reward. Right now these are all rescues of a Wanderer hero, but we have some plans for other special missions in the future.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38550877/32badb2caef027281f921be63b2b0071499fcf68.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38550877/cef5d2988f8e4059e3d8369ba4c7561c003009d6.jpg[/img]
[h2]QoL Features[/h2]
We've also added quite a few quality of life and other requested features, such as an [b]Auto Battle[/b] option, a [b]Battle Log[/b], hover info on battle icons, party menu improvements, some improved interface features specifically for mouse users, and various other little things.

[h2]Changelog for version 0.4.6[/h2]
The following is a list of changes from the previous 0.4.5b beta branch version.
[list]
[*] Fixed bug where overlapping enemy sprites were sometimes not hidden properly when taking damage
[*] Fixed Samurai's Sword Tech skills being usable at less than 100% charge
[*] Fixed town upgrades based on Boss Badge progress not applying properly to Claire's sub-forms
[*] Fixed Ka being able to use Takedown without level 3 Sabertooth on Caveman
[*] Fixed Paladin's Oaths not being swappable after being rescued in Singularity mode
[*] Fixed enemy Toxic Spores skill not being resistable
[*] Fixed Pursuer's PR3D Missile not resetting charge between battles
[*] Addressed a possible rare soft-lock issue related to taunt skill in the Big Blob boss fight
[*] Reduced the number of enemy kills needed for two of Medbot's quests
[*] Town vendor now has one guaranteed slot for non-hero relics and one for single use bundle items
[*] Fixed Forest Heart boss' animations breaking during later phases
[*] Adjusted Forest Heart boss' lost turn type spore effects to be less punishing and limited in number
[*] Kraken boss can now only summon 2 tentacles at a time instead of 3, and tentacles have a little less HP
[/list]

notes.title: Version 0.4.0b Release: Quest Update (Beta Branch)
notes.notes:
Build version 0.4.0b is finally here, available to download in the beta branch. This release adds a compete overhaul of the character leveling system, an endless mode rework, an overhaul of building upgrades, and many quality of life features asked for by a lot of players.

If you missed our previous developer update about this release, you can read the major details here:

https://steamcommunity.com/games/1393500/announcements/detail/3082145182492980834

[h3]How do I download the Beta Branch?[/h3]
Opting into a Beta branch is easy on Steam. Simply right click Time Break Chronicles in your Library, select Properties, and then click "Betas." From there you can select the Beta branch from the dropdown, and Steam will download the files for you. You do not need to enter a beta access code.

[h3]Will this affect my existing save?[/h3]
This update is designed to work with existing saves. Any unlocks you've achieved so far won't be overwritten; the methods of getting new unlocks has simply changed. However, the level up related updates are probably best experienced on a fresh save.

You might receive some new tutorial popups when loading into the save. If you were mid-run in your save, it is possible the map might reset you back to the starting node. In this case, you should just abandon the run and start a new one.

If you would like to make a manual backup of your save anyway, you can find the files at [b]%APP_DATA%/Warrior General Games/TimeBreak[/b] on Windows. We [b]cannot guarantee[/b] saves from the beta version will transfer properly back to the current live version, so this should be considered a [b]one-way[/b] upgrade.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38550877/e4873dce3c2e83d8c4a59e44b9ba7168694c5924.png[/img]

[h2]Changelog for version 0.4.0b[/h2]

[h3]All Modes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Reworked the Distortion generation code to generate distortions mid-mission instead of at map-gen. This fixes the occasional problem of running out of them on very long maps

notes.title: Developer Update: Upcoming Version 0.4
notes.notes:
We've been hard at work for a while on the next big patch for Time Break Chronicles, which is aimed at improving some of the areas on which we've received the most feedback, criticism, and feature requests.

This update started out with a smaller scale in mind, but it's now gotten pretty big, with a lot of new features and quality of life updates as well. We're finally reaching a point where it's close to being ready for release, so we're going to show off some of the upcoming new features in this update post, with some screenshots using the various available UI styles.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38550877/eb1eb69fbd01393f35a3f4c3b1847bf2613525a7.jpg[/img]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38550877/f62f7b23cdcb492aa36791616e3aa62a779c3e99.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38550877/a0e19ef365efa1d54974c958a8d46d8333887307.jpg[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38550877/5c1046c800e6b88ed3b19aa270f23d0246b393b2.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38550877/552f3fb1efcc338bdad6398d15d95cd7d6c27993.jpg[/img][/url]
[h2]Hero Quests, XP, and Skill Points[/h2]
One of the most frequent things we've heard from players is that the game tends to involve too much "grinding" to find the appropriate skill books to level up, and to acquire the relics you most want to use. It would be much more fun to just play the game, using the various heroes available as best you can, and make progress as you go!

To address this, we've removed all the various skill book types except for Encyclopedia (which has a heavily reduced drop rate), and added a new system for leveling up skills. Heroes will instead earn skill points through 3 different methods: 
[list]
[*] Defeating bosses for the first time to earn a [b]Boss Badge[/b]
[*] Earning [b]XP[/b] in battles like a traditional RPG
[*] Completing specific [b]Hero Quests[/b]
[/list]You can then spend the skill points to level up skills, even mid-mission. This system also serves to level out the difficulty curve from Act 1 to Act 2 much more smoothly, since you'll be steadily earning skill points instead of getting books in small dumps.

Every hero has 3 unique quests that, when completed, award them skill points and another new feature: an [b]Infinite Relic[/b]. Claire also has several quests tailored for her various forms.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38550877/141346585475bfb1af934c576e98fb45a0865c6f.jpg[/img]
[h2]Infinite Relics[/h2]
By completing the relevant quests, hero-specific relics can now become infinite. Infinite relics can be duplicated as many times as you want for free, allowing you more freedom to bind them to any hero you'd like.

Boss relics, shop relics, and relics found only via missions will still need to be either found or crafted, but this also serves to make them a bit more special, and will allow us to add a few more of them as well.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38550877/9d295959c1f79d0414c026e0e92cbe528e2d7b7d.jpg[/img]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38550877/46c2fc526f764d0821e971712e59d42ae767c50a.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38550877/4ac40505896fdeaddfdbb11115abb21828ce8b21.jpg[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38550877/16fdf4f006b12bacb8418a21cbef783ea51f6094.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38550877/93d3d2df6563033262646fc11a91972a8acbd97c.jpg[/img][/url]
[h2]Town Progress Meter and Building Upgrade Overhaul[/h2]
Another point of feedback has been that the building upgrades aren't as interesting as they could be, they cost too much, and there's too many options presented at once. Now that particles don't need to be spent primarily on acquiring skill books and relics, a larger focus will be on purchasing building upgrades.

We've reduced the cost of the building upgrades in general, and reworked many of them to provide more interesting effects that add more "flavor" to various damage types or situations. In addition, instead of purchasing the buildings, they will be unlocked via a town progress bar that increases as you rescue and level up new heroes. This also further serves to incentivize trying out new heroes and completing their quests.

The Town Progress bar also unlocks other things over time, such as Time Break techs, additional reserve and bundle slots, and Skill Points for Claire.

[h2]Endless Mode Overhaul[/h2]
We don't have any screenshots to show of this at the moment, because the interface is still a bit in flux, but Endless mode has also received a facelift. It will now work similarly to Singularity mode, in that each level will present a set of specific challenges, instead of simply increasing the levels of the enemies. Defeat the final challenge, and you might even find something special!

Speaking of Singularity mode, heroes in that mode will also now earn XP like they do in Chronicle. This allows for a bit more creativity when choosing your rewards after the battle, since encyclopedias won't be quite as important to take.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38550877/2a2fefd271fdabb02089da330dbcb39297a632f2.jpg[/img]
[h2]Special Missions[/h2]
With the overhaul to Endless mode, wanderer hero rescues have now been moved to a new [b]Special Missions[/b] feature. At certain times, Quinn will present Special Missions aside the main story to earn special rewards. These are short custom-crafted missions with unique encounters, leading to a reward. Right now these are all rescues of a Wanderer hero, but we have some plans for other special missions in the future.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38550877/32badb2caef027281f921be63b2b0071499fcf68.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38550877/cef5d2988f8e4059e3d8369ba4c7561c003009d6.jpg[/img]
[h2]QoL Features[/h2]
We've also added quite a few quality of life and other requested features, such as an [b]Auto Battle[/b] option, a [b]Battle Log[/b], hover info on battle icons, party menu improvements, some improved interface features specifically for mouse users, and various other little things.

We're hoping to finish the last bits of this update and get it out the the beta branch soon™ so you can try it out. Thanks for your patience and feedback, everyone!

notes.title: Version 0.3.8 Release: Woodlands

Version 0.3.8 has officially left the beta branch and is now in the stable branch! We'd like to thank everyone who downloaded the beta and provided feedback and bug reports. If you'd like to join in and talk about the game or provide feedback as well, come and join the community on our discord at https://discord.gg/m9MAfrP !

The next major update we have planned will involve a rework of endless mode to be a bit more interesting, with some structured challenges to overcome. We will also be working on the next hero pack, and of course moving on to Act 4 content.

This beta branch patch has some balance updates related to suggestions we have been discussing with players, some updates we want to get feedback on prior to the release of Act 3, as well as a few bug fixes. 

[h3]New Mechanic: Debuff Resist Stacks[/h3]
The main change we think should help improve strategy surrounding debuffs, and should also improve clarity for the player as to how and when debuffs are resisted. A new stackable element called "Resist" will appear on some enemies and heroes, and each stack of Resist will block one incoming debuff. So, you'll need to work through the stacks to apply debuffs to resistant enemies, but the old random resistance mechanic has been removed.

[h3]New Mechanic: Attribute Cap[/h3]
The other big change is that attributes are now capped at 500% of their base value. This should help curb some runaway attributes for certain heroes and some enemies that can scale exceptionally large over time. When you reach a cap on an attribute, it will be displayed with an asterisk next to it.

The full changelog for this patch is below. [b][i]Note that these changes are ONLY in the beta branch, and not in the main stable branch right now.[/i][/b] We'll move this patch over to the stable branch reasonably soon, however, after some testing.

notes.title: Version 0.2.21 Release: Singularity Mode
notes.notes:
With version 0.2.21, we are happy to move the new Singularity Mode from the beta branch to the main branch. Thanks to everyone who downloaded the beta and provided feedback. You do not need to unsubscribe from the beta branch if you are currently using it, as both beta and stable branches have been updated.

Now, on to the details of the major changes we've been testing on the beta branch.

[h2]Singularity Mode Features[/h2]
Singularity mode is aimed at players who would like a more traditional Rogue-like experience, without meta progression, or just something different. This new mode is separate from the original game mode, which we are calling Chronicle Mode, though you can earn loot for your Chronicle Mode save by playing it.  So what's new in this mode?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38550877/6c4d54310f9f9629728032c6ef2a9090ae2bd376.jpg[/img]
[h3]No Claire[/h3]
Singularity Mode lets you play with a variety of heroes as your team leader. You'll start by choosing two heroes, and add more as you find them over the course of the run. Adding new heroes to your team will unlock them as possible starters for future runs.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38550877/8eef2f72cbbecb872df72c1a2b355957b1b2a024.jpg[/img]
[h3]No Meta Progression[/h3]
Akin to a more classic Roguelike, there is no meta-progression in this mode outside of unlocking new difficulties and heroes. You'll find a multitude of skill training books, heroes, and relics as battle rewards. This mode is all about experimentation and making do with the choices given to you.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38550877/594701820ffe373e3b6aca72309355ffcafd4214.jpg[/img]
[h3]Challenge Increasing Difficulties[/h3]
As you win runs in Singularity Mode, additional difficulty modifiers will open up, making for more challenging runs. Winning more challenging difficulties will provide more Chronicle Mode rewards, and of course there are achievements to be earned.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38550877/e6e956a18e4d88325c999a573122025e96a420c4.png[/img]
[h3]Earn Loot for Chronicle Mode[/h3]
Playing Singularity Mode will award you Singularity Geodes, which can be cracked open in any Chronicle Mode temple to receive random loot. This can be books, relics, particles, or soul gems. Winning will grant you more geodes, but even if you lose your run, you'll still get at least one.

notes.notes:
Version 0.2.16 (Rewards Update) has officially left the beta branch, and is now in Stable.  We'd like to thank everyone who downloaded the beta and provided feedback. You do not need to unsubscribe from the beta branch if you are currently using it, as both beta and stable branches have been updated.

Now, on to the details of the major changes we've been testing on the beta branch. Potential spoilers have been hidden somewhat below.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38550877/96de3c9a8039984b1b00b202c54e220f2c0a01a3.jpg[/img]
[h3]New Rewards System[/h3]
To address feedback related to how grinding for items could feel too punishing, we have changed the way we handle rewards when you lose a run.

Now, instead of losing all your books and relics and 50% of particles when losing a run, you will instead keep all books and relics, but lose all particles. To offset the particle loss some, your Town will generate particles passively while you adventure, based on how many heroes you have unlocked.

We have also adjusted the loot tables and reward chances to make defeating bosses, elites, and midbosses more rewarding, and there is a new useful "farming" item you'll receive after beating Act 1.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38550877/70e0b83e6c6a0475340415e8f0b0852aacaf427f.jpg[/img]
[h3]New Act 1 and 2 Completion Rewards[/h3]
[spoiler]When you complete Act 1, you will now receive a new bundle item, the Transmitter, which automatically transfers some collected particles back to down as you adventure. [/spoiler] This item is designed to help make farming easier, or protect some of the particles you collect in difficult runs.

Act 2 now awards the [spoiler]Particle Beacon difficulty modifier item[/spoiler] on completion, and the old Transmogrifier item has been removed.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38550877/f8c2c580bef480fa0e803059519be76751bc8158.jpg[/img]
[h3]Modified [spoiler]Cursed Mirror[/spoiler] Battle[/h3]
No boss battle has received as much feedback about frustration as this one, especially for certain team compositions, so we've redesigned the start of the fight a bit to help. [spoiler]Instead of your mirrored clones receiving free turns, they will now start the battle "ethereal." This makes them immune to damage until their next turn.[/spoiler] Hopefully this helps alleviate some frustration for teams who need a chance to set up some.

notes.title: Version 0.2.10 Release: Hero Pack #2
notes.notes:
Version 0.2.10 (Hero Pack #2) has officially left the beta branch, and is now in the stable branch! We'd like to thank everyone who downloaded the beta and provided feedback. You do not need to unsubscribe from the beta branch if you are currently using it, as both beta and stable branches have been updated. Now, on to the details of the major changes we've been testing on the beta branch.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38550877/77ef13d3069339e32525d282c59c0a609a80adb6.jpg[/img]
[h3]Three New Heroes[/h3]
Ralf the Jester, Asariel the Angel, and Curtis the Boxer are now available to find as wanderers in your endless runs. Each also has a unique rescue battle you'll need to overcome to unlock them, so get out there and take it to the Cult!

[h3]New Reserve Party System[/h3]
When you start a mission, you will now be asked to take along some reserve party members. Reserve party members do not lose stamina when in reserve, and can be swapped with another hero freely via the Party menu. Any rescues or reinforcements you gather during the mission will be added directly to reserves, so you can use them more freely immediately.

[h3]Battle Menu Redesign[/h3]
We've made the text a bit smaller and the menus more streamlined in battles. It's now easier to see and choose from a hero's skills at a glance.

[h3]Changelog from 0.2.9b[/h3]
[list]
[*] Blob enemys' Bomb attacks are now classified as spells
[*] Kiara's (Banshee) Wail skill is now just a normal MP-based skill, instead of charging on allies being downed
[*] Kiara's (Banshee) Posession skill now requires charge up over time but lasts 3 turns instead of 1
[*] Sovras' (Necromancer) Death Shroud skill reworked to give access to Ritual and Dark Bargain skills, and use Aspect skill type
[*] Paul's (Linebacker) Blitz Stance bonus reduced from 1x speed to 0.5x
[*] Fixed possible softlock with George's (General) Command skill after cancelling targeting
[*] Fixed a possible crash when applying Gelatinous Goo and Hardened Stone relics to Seth (Lizardman)
[/list]

A list of all the other changes from the last stable version is listed in the in-game changelog.

notes.title: Version 0.2.8b Release: Hero Pack 2 (beta branch)
notes.notes:
Version 0.2.8b is now available in the beta branch, with 3 new wanderer heroes for you to rescue in endless mode, and a few other changes that we think help make things more interesting. Once we're happy with feedback and any bug fixes, this update will make its way to the main branch.

[h2]Changelog for version 0.2.8b[/h2]
[list]
[*] First off, the three new heroes. These heroes are classified as "wanderers" and can only be rescued in endless mode (of any act).
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38550877/77ef13d3069339e32525d282c59c0a609a80adb6.jpg[/img]
[h3]Ralf, the Jester[/h3]
He may be dressed like a fool, but Ralf is an expert at juggling and throwing blades with deadly accuracy, even several at a time. He can also inspire his allies into action with a jaunty tune played on his flute, if he so chooses.

[h3]Asariel, the Angel[/h3]
Sent as an emissary from the Kingdom of Heaven, Asariel wields the holy powers of resurrection, healing, and protection. As an angel, she is also a warrior in her own right, imploring evil doers to repent lest they feel the burn of her Holy Blast.

[h3]Curtis, the Boxer[/h3]
Jab, jab, uppercut, hook! Curtis is the master of combo punching and quick feet. Start with a simple jab and build up to a powerful combo finisher to put your opponent on the mat! Curtis is also no slouch defensively, as he powers up with an adrenaline rush or nullifies enemy attacks with a solid block.

[h3]New Reserve Party System[/h3]
Another major update included in this patch is a new system that we think will make it more fun and worthwhile to take rescues and reinforcements, and help better manage stamina in an engaging way.

When you start a mission, you will now be asked to take along some reserve party members. Reserve party members do not lose stamina when in reserve, and can be swapped with another hero freely via the Party menu. Any rescues or reinforcements you gather during the mission will be added directly to reserves, so you can use them more freely immediately.

notes.title: Patch version 0.1.15
notes.notes:
We've got a medium-sized update for you today, which includes some bug fixes, and changes and additions to some of the core systems of the game, based on your feedback.

[h2]Changelog for version 0.1.15[/h2]

[h3]New Feature: Book Binding[/h3]
The Book Binder is an upgrade you can now purchase on the Library building. It will allow you to convert stacks of duplicate Skill Books into other random books. With enough books, you can even just craft an Encyclopedia to train any skill.

[h3]New Feature: Infinite Bonus Upgrades[/h3]
The three unlockable town buildings now have a special upgrade that can be purchased multiple times, with an exponentially scaling cost. They each grant +1 to three different attributes for all heroes.

[h3]Item Bundle Changes[/h3]
Our goal with these changes is to remove some of the hurdle for new players in selecting from the available item bundles, and to give more freedom to choose various mission items without worrying about cost.
[list]
[*] Item bundles when starting a mission are now free, but the number of slots for them has been reduced.
[*] You can only select one of each type of bundle.
[*] We have removed some of the more "advanced" bundles from the starting list to help guide newer players into selecting more useful stuff early game. Additional bundles can be unlocked via town upgrades.
[/list]
[h3]Camping Changes[/h3]
Our goal with these changes is to increase the choice of paths you can take during the mission, instead of tending to always just go for the path with the most camps.
[list]
[*] Camping Supplies have been changed to a new item: Stimulant Pod. These allow you to restore 15 stamina to all allies at any time from the party item menu, as opposed to requiring a camp to use them.
[*] Camp sites have been reduced to only appear before the mid and end boss fights, but they now restore 30 stamina for free.
[*] One Stimulant Pod is now a guaranteed reward from Extreme Danger combats.
[*] You can bring a free Stimulant Pod via an Item Bundle when starting a mission, and of course find them in battle or chest rewards.
[/list]
[h3]Hero Balance Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Cain's Chaos Storm level 3 now returns 25% of MP instead of 50%.
[*] Cain's Unstable Generator now also reduces MP healing he receives by 50%.
[*] Downed allies now also count as "critical" for skill effect purposes.
[/list]
[h3]Bug Fixes/Other[/h3]
[list]
[*] Missing achievements have been added for the recent Hero Pack heroes (Clown, Linebacker, Maelstrom). If you've already rescued them, the achievements should be awarded the next time you visit town.
[*] Fixed bug where Cain's Unstable Generator level 2 effect procced at level 1.
[*] Fixed some display bugs with Darius and Samuel's gun sprites' visibility timing.
[*] Vendors now play a "ka-ching" sound when you buy something, instead of no sound.
[/list]

notes.title: Developer Update #1
notes.notes:
Now that we have most of the major launch bugs and feature requests worked out, we wanted to post an update on Development progress as we continue on to work on the content for the upcoming Frozen Tundra update. We'll be posting more of these sorts of updates as we go along.

First, we wanted to thank everyone who has contributed bug reports, feedback, and content. We're also glad to see many of you enjoying theorycrafting and pushing the difficulty in endless run attempts. We make games for you, the players, so it's great to see participation in the community!

The main feature of this post is to showcase a couple of the upcoming heroes you'll be able to find amongst the ice and snow. Let's start with Claire's new Frozen form! When Frozen Tundra releases, this form will unlock for anyone who has completed the Wasteland story mission.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38550877/6559e5d774185ade3c103e02947d1163587c480e.png[/img]

[h2]Frozen Form Claire[/h2]
This Claire uses science and technology to master her environment, the ice and snow of the Tundra. She can encase herself in ice for protection, and can apply piercing ice type damage to her and her allies' attacks. She can also summon an automated drone to pelt enemies with ice attacks.

As always, she will be able to borrow skills from many of the upcoming heroes, and a few of the existing ones.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38550877/41edb8237c5e3abcfbdea385f6efb213331f5efb.png[/img]

[h2]Sovras, the Necromancer[/h2]
Sovras is centered around dealing Dark type damage while using endless hordes of undead as literal meat shields. Not content to sit in the back lines, Sovras actually works best as a tank. He automatically summons Zombies who block damage for him and dish out some damage of their own. In addition, he has various way to reduce and redirect incoming damage, steal health, and even avoid death itself. 

Offensively, Sovras' featured skill, Grave's Call, guides enemies to their demise, which deals increasing Dark type damage as his target loses HP, and can keep them from Bleeding Out.

Sovras' relics provide Physical and Dark damage mitigation effects, and access to his Grave's Call skill.

[h2]What's Next?[/h2]
We'll be posting more of these updates, with character reveals and other things, as we continue working on things and get closer to our next content release. We hope you're having fun with the current content, but we certainly want to get more of it into your hands!
